mapper.select: SELECT b.id, b.factory_id, b.cutting_plan_id, b.order_id, o.order_no, o.style_id, s.style_code, s.style_name, b.color, b.size, b.fabric, b.part, cp.bed_no, cp.barcode, b.bundle_no, b.global_bundle_no, b.qty, b.cutting_pieces, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT op.process_id) FROM order_process op WHERE op.order_id = b.order_id) AS total_processes, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT wr.process_id) FROM work_report wr WHERE wr.status = 1 AND wr.bundle_id IN ( SELECT b2.id FROM bundle b2 WHERE b2.bundle_no = b.bundle_no AND b2.order_id = b.order_id )) AS completed_processes, b.created_at FROM bundle b LEFT JOIN `order` o ON b.order_id = o.id AND o.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN style s ON o.style_id = s.id AND s.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN cutting_plan cp ON b.cutting_plan_id = cp.id AND cp.deleted = 0 WHERE b.id = #{bundleId}

SELECT p.id AS process_id, p.name AS process_name, CASE WHEN wr.process_id IS NOT NULL THEN true ELSE false END AS completed, e.name AS employee_name, wr.report_time FROM order_process op INNER JOIN process p ON op.process_id = p.id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT wr2.process_id, wr2.employee_id, MAX(wr2.report_time) AS report_time FROM work_report wr2 WHERE wr2.status = 1 AND wr2.bundle_id IN ( SELECT b.id FROM bundle b WHERE b.bundle_no = (SELECT b2.bundle_no FROM bundle b2 WHERE b2.id = #{bundleId}) AND b.order_id = (SELECT b3.order_id FROM bundle b3 WHERE b3.id = #{bundleId}) ) GROUP BY wr2.process_id ) wr ON wr.process_id = op.process_id LEFT JOIN employee e ON wr.employee_id = e.id WHERE op.order_id = #{orderId} ORDER BY op.sort
